text: You are going to investigate the effect of different concentrations of salt solution on a hollow plant
You have been provided with a 2% salt solution and distilled water. You are going to use these to
make up different concentrations of salt solution.
Read all the instructions but DO NOT CARRY THEM OUT until you have drawn a table for
your results in the space provided in 1(a)(ii).
